Get directions ↗Meet Studio IX ↗
Why the threads? +

The Ix site’s textile story began in 1928. Today, the neighborhood brings together art, work, and community. This design takes its cue from that history: individual threads becoming something stronger together.

Explore the Ix history ↗
05 / BEFORE YOU COME

Room for
your questions.

Your first meetup doesn’t have
to feel like a first day.

Is this for beginners? +

Absolutely. The community welcomes people who want to learn practical AI skills alongside people already building. Curiosity is a good place to start.

Do I need to code? +

No coding or design experience is required for the September bake-off. Join a team, bring ideas, try a tool, or learn by watching.

What if I don’t have a laptop? +

For the September bake-off, bring one if you want to operate the tools yourself. You can also contribute ideas or follow along with your team. Everyone is welcome to participate.

How do I join the conversation? +

Find #cvilleaiexplorers on Cville Slack. Need an invitation? Contact an organizer through Meetup. Please follow the Cville Slack Code of Conduct.
